objective.definition: Count opened pull requests that replace the temporary managed-tools path with one reviewed session kernel and pass the lifecycle, database-analysis, provider-parity, migration, and repository gates at the PR head.

prior_anti_goal_review.dropped_rule: Drop candidates whose activation surface is parking-lot, homepage, benchmark-only, unrelated lint-rule authoring, release, deployment, or another completed context; retain all SDK, Lite lifecycle, authority, graph, testing, storage, and independence walls.

dkrs.decision_target: Retain the observed Lite lifecycle semantics, reject global cleanup topology, keep business finalization in named flows, and reopen Lite only on a proven reusable invariant.

retained: parent close does not join child streams
current close and release are not joinable
no Lite change in the first PR
superseded: business checkpoint or sealing during context close

dkrs.stop_rule: Stop when one option has source-backed semantics, executable conformance cases, and independent Claude plus challenger review, or return an unresolved checkpoint.

dkrs.decision_target: Define and replay the rich SessionRecord plus SessionRuntime kernel: WorkRecord, WorkAttempt, Invocation, ControlEvent, authority rebinding, immutable tool snapshots, branching, scheduling, memory, files, streaming, steering, explicit finishSession, and root-owned physical resources.
dkrs.stop_rule: Stop when the database-analysis replay distinguishes durable records from live attempts and invocations, proves finish-before-close, authority rebinding, snapshot identity, wait-without-live-leases, branch join versus merge, steering fencing, and two-session root lifetime.

dkrs.decision_target: Choose final public names, compatibility and deprecation boundaries, provider transport lifetime, real Claude/Codex cancellation and streaming parity, validation-engine placement, event backpressure, and the smallest first-PR package surface without MCP or duplicate runtimes.
dkrs.stop_rule: Stop with a public API map, preserved and retired surfaces, provider capability matrix, changeset boundary, implementation PKRs, and independent review.

orchestrator.terminal_condition: Continue until the objective metric reaches target, the human stops or changes the frame, or a blocking flag requires human resolution.
